scheme_name: Internship Programme By The Ministry Of External Affairs
other_conditions: Candidate must be an Indian citizen
Minimum educational qualification: graduate degree from a recognized university
Final‑year students may apply if the internship is a mandatory part of their curriculum
Age must not exceed 25 years as on 31 December of the internship year
Preference given to candidates from Transformation of Aspirational Districts Programme (TADP) areas and to SC/ST/OBC/EWS categories
benefits_summary: Interns receive a monthly honorarium of ₹10,000 and a one‑time air‑travel allowance, along with exposure to the functioning of the Ministry of External Affairs.
